title: Selected Work
subtitle: Craft in production, design systems that ship as engineering infrastructure, and AI-native design–engineering — selected for HelloFresh

bio.short: I'm Tobias Treppmann, a design leader in Berlin. Fifteen years across four Head- and Director-of-design tenures, most recently at Bibel TV, where the design system ships as a live token API across Web, iOS, Android and Figma, and where the color engine that themes every card in the catalog is one I built and shipped in production. I lead through the work rather than around it, and I've been running an AI-native design–engineering practice long enough to have opinions about what breaks.
bio.long:
I'm Tobias Treppmann, a design leader in Berlin. Fifteen-plus years leading design at product-first companies — Bibel TV, ChurchDesk, Ninox, Datameer — with hiring, coaching and performance calls made across design and writing. I lead through the work, not around it.

At Bibel TV the design system ships as an API: Style Dictionary in a Git repo, three-tier tokens (primitives → semantic → component), automated sync across Web, iOS, Android and Figma. The color engine that themes every card in the catalog is one I built in OKLCH with WCAG contrast validation, live in production — the off-the-shelf palette extractor made half the artwork disappear, so design kept the thresholds and the tokens rather than delegating to a generic library. Prototypes are generated with agentic coding and engineering consumes the prototype code directly. At ChurchDesk I reframed a funeral-booking feature into a booking capability wired deep into the platform, shipped to twenty-plus cemeteries in two months on a €20k budget, and cut coordination from days of phone-tag to hours. At Ninox I ran a team of five designers plus a design lead, hired one designer and one writer, let go one of each, and coached the design lead through a difficult engineering-lead partnership — including redesigning the team's collaboration system so a sidelined neurodivergent engineer could actually participate.

What I care about is that the design decisions inside the pipeline stay with design — the color thresholds, the token architecture, the interaction agency the user actually gets when AI writes the first draft. I'm plain-spoken, comfortable moving without a map, and I've been shipping consumer-facing work in production, in Berlin, from the same office you'd hire me into.

context.company: HelloFresh Group / HelloTech — Consumer UX team inside the Consumer mega alliance. Eight brands, sixteen markets, 6M+ subscribers. Berlin HQ.
context.role: Director UX Design — a leadership role in a matrixed alliance alongside peer Directors, not solo design lead. Owns hiring, coaching and developing designers from IC through managers; owns execution across a product line at consumer scale; is expected to be a design-technologist and to have a POV on AI-native design.
context.emphasis: Lead with leads-through-the-work + AI-native + design-engineering credibility — the differentiator against typical Director candidates. Foreground shipped-in-production craft (color engine, design-system-as-API), bias to ship at product-line scale (ChurchDesk booking, 70/90/95 metrics), matrixed peer among functional heads (Datameer 5-year director tenure), hiring and performance calls (Ninox), coaching design leads (Ninox). Berlin base, German native, English C2, EU work rights.
context.avoid: Do NOT claim 6M+ B2C consumer scale — largest documented is Spreadshirt (hundreds of thousands, 2014–2016) and Bibel TV (<1M). Frame as a growth arc, not existing scope. Do NOT claim multi-brand experience — no genuinely-distinct brand identities on shared tokens; the honest bridge is multi-surface consistency (Web / iOS / Android / Figma sync at Bibel TV). Do NOT claim a motion showreel — motion evidence is easing curves added to the design system as system-thinking, not a dedicated consumer-motion showcase. Do NOT claim FMCG or meal-kit category expertise — zero. Do NOT frame as an IC role — this is a Director-tier leadership pitch.

selection_rationale.bibeltv-color-api: Featured #1 — the craft anchor. HelloFresh's JD names 'zest-appeal' and 'the last 10%' explicitly; this is the closest thing in the portfolio to that language in production. K-means + OKLCH + WCAG contrast validation, shipped, beating the off-the-shelf palette extractor because design kept the thresholds and tokens rather than delegating them to a generic library. Direct hit on JD Priority 3 (craft authority) and Priority 2 (bias to ship). In-depth format — the design decisions that make this case study credible strip out at executive altitude.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-design-system-api: Featured #2 — design-technologist + multi-brand bridge. Style Dictionary + Git repo + automated sync across Web / iOS / Android / Figma with a three-tier token hierarchy. Direct hit on JD Priority 4 (design-engineering boundary, component architecture, front-end-constraints fluency). Also the honest multi-brand bridge per Q2 discipline — 'multi-surface consistency on a shared token foundation' is the transferable capability against Zest across 8 brands and 16 markets; explicitly NOT a multi-brand claim. In-depth format because the three-tier architecture + sync mechanics + governance model compress badly.
selection_rationale.churchdesk-booking-system: Featured #3 — ship-at-scale + cross-functional advocacy. 70% coordination-time reduction (days → hours), 90% booking acceptance rate, 20+ cemeteries in 2 months on €20k. Reframed 'funeral-booking feature' into 'booking capability deeply integrated into the platform' — held the design line on scope against pressure toward the cheaper standalone-module path. Direct hit on JD Priority 2 (bias to ship at product-line scale) + Priority 7-adjacent (cross-functional advocacy under pressure). In-depth format because the build-vs-buy narrative + measurable outcomes + regulated context compress badly. Only featured case study with full real screenshots already staged in the portfolio repo.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-agentic-engineering: Browseable #1 — AI-native + design-engineering bridge. Web + Android prototypes generated via agentic coding, engineering consuming prototype code directly in production. Active team evangelism of vibe-coded prototyping. Direct hit on JD Priority 5 (AI-native design practice, Claude named in JD) and Priority 4 (design-technologist mindset). Executive format keeps it complementary to the design-system-api anchor rather than competing.
selection_rationale.ninox-org-building: Browseable #2 — the leadership evidence. Performance calls in both directions (hired 1 designer + 1 writer, let go 1 of each). Coached the design lead through a difficult engineering-lead partnership; personally redesigned the collaboration system (pre-meeting prep, written agendas, structured turn-taking, documented decisions) to include a sidelined neurodivergent engineer. Direct hit on JD Priority 1 (design leadership from IC through managers) — reframes 'leading a team' as 'a design problem'. Executive format because HelloFresh's JD is craft-and-ship-shaped, not headcount-shaped; the leadership signal is complementary depth, not the featured anchor.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-app-redesign: Browseable #3 — current-B2C consumer craft. Mobile-app redesign to broaden reach + engagement and defend against global market entrants (Pray.com, Hallow). The most direct 'shipped consumer-mobile design at a subscription-media platform' evidence in the portfolio, though at Bibel TV's <1M scale (Q1 discipline: framing is honest, not fabricated 6M).
selection_rationale.ninox-ai-onboarding: Browseable #4 — AI-in-product with a user-agency principle. Prompt-to-database with split-screen direct manipulation and 'show output and let users edit'. Second AI story surfacing the design principles behind AI product integration (versus agentic-engineering, which is AI in the design practice). Executive format keeps it complementary.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-support-agent: Hidden — narrower fit for a consumer-craft-and-shipping JD. Handbook-as-context Copilot with escalation-as-first-class-output is strong AI evidence, but agentic-engineering + ninox-ai-onboarding already cover the AI dimension from more relevant angles (design practice + product integration). Kept reachable via ?all for the AI-in-CS-ops reader.
selection_rationale.datameer-data-dense-analytics: Hidden — Datameer's 5-year director tenure + matrixed-peer positioning is a load-bearing CV bullet (see cv-tailoring-notes §Datameer), not a portfolio surface. Also older (2016–2021) and B2B-regulated-data-analytics rather than B2C-consumer-food-tech. Kept for ?all.
selection_rationale.spreadshirt-user-research-strategy: Hidden — the historical hundreds-of-thousands-of-consumers scale anchor. Lives in CV Older Experience block (cv-tailoring-notes §Spreadshirt) rather than portfolio surface, because it's a decade old and the JD reads current craft over historical scale.
selection_rationale.bibeltv-ai-prototyping: Hidden — status=in-progress with known AI-slop issues from prior reviews (see n8n/xentral filter rationales). Substantially overlaps bibeltv-agentic-engineering, which is the writing-quality-gate-safe surface for that story.
